$comment: Design choice, not fact: every camera value (center, zoom, pitch, bearing, zoomShift) and every layer was picked to prove the sentence the stop sits by (map tours batch 3, 22 Oct 2026). Facts: text is a sentence of the guide, or a tightened form of one; cite is from the cite list of the guide chapter or fly it comes from. Points are the IGN place names of data/story/names-campo-de-borja.geojson or the river's own line.

facts.label: Somontano del Moncayo
facts.text: It takes in the Somontano del Moncayo, the land at the foot of the Moncayo massif.

facts.label: Magallón
facts.text: The oldest record of vines here is a gift of vineyards at Magallón in 1203, kept in the archives of the Monasterio de Veruela.

facts.label: Ainzón
facts.text: In 1453 the abbots bought the town of Ainzón, above all to grow its vineyard.

facts.label: Moncayo
facts.text: The mountain sways the climate of the zone and gives its wines character.

facts.label: Borja
facts.text: Rain is scarce. It averages 350 mm in the low zones and rises to 450 mm in the higher ones.

facts.label: Río Huecha
facts.text: This tributary of the Ebro laid the terrace soils of the middle zone.
